answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through power-grid frequency attestation. Agents submit real-time alternating-current phase proofs across an attestation bridge. Because grid noise is unpredictable, adversaries cannot replay signals, rendering captured data an obsolete relic. Creating fake identities requires scarce, dedicated physical grid taps across separated locations, from valleys to a mountain summit. However, nodes on DC batteries lack grid coupling and face false rejections.
